description: This file is a CodeMirror addon implementing search cursor functionality, including regex and string search in a text document.

classes.name: SearchCursor
classes.description: A class for iterating over search matches within a CodeMirror document, supporting forward and backward search with regex or string queries.

methods.name: findNext
methods.description: Finds the next occurrence of the search query.

methods.name: findPrevious
methods.description: Finds the previous occurrence of the search query.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Performs the search in the specified direction.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Returns the start position of the current match.

methods.name: to
methods.description: Returns the end position of the current match.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces the current match with new text.
